objective: Design Blaine Completion Contracts as a durable Task primitive and E1 read-only workspace capabilities as its first consumer, with documentation, contracts, ADRs, fixtures and acceptance definitions only; no runtime, client or transport implementation.

context.need: Kernel Task, verifier, PolicyGate, human, memory and workspace primitives; Hub design, roadmap and ADR index
JetBrains ACP and IntelliJ MCP server delegation and scope semantics

allowed: documentation, contract, ADR and fixture changes
forbidden: modify live workstation or Hub transport
modify or depend on the E0.D worktree

completion.criterion: Completion Contract model covers durable shape, provenance/precedence, amendments, verifier taxonomy, deterministic/semantic/human boundaries, completion legality, crash/retry, evidence linkage and memory interaction
E1 design covers workspace, delegation/authority, capability contract, protocol, confinement, disconnect, no-write evidence, contract examples, acceptance and E2 extension
completion.evidence: Review docs/contracts/workspace-capability.md, ADR 0027 and the Hub revisions

completion.criterion: Documentation-only change is validated and committed locally without publication
completion.evidence: JSON and link/anchor checks, git diff --check, documentation-only changed-file list and local commit identities
